scene_jp: <ruby>バーテンダー<rt>バーテンダー</rt></ruby>の<ruby>男<rt>おとこ</rt></ruby>は、グラスを<ruby>磨<rt>みが</rt></ruby>きながらゆっくりと<ruby>口<rt>くち</rt></ruby>を<ruby>開<rt>ひら</rt></ruby>いた。「<ruby>君<rt>きみ</rt></ruby>のお<ruby>祖母<rt>ばあ</rt></ruby>さんは、<ruby>毎<rt>まい</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt>つき</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt>いち</rt></ruby><ruby>度<rt>ど</rt></ruby>ここへ<ruby>来<rt>き</rt></ruby>ていたよ。<ruby>何<rt>なに</rt></ruby>かを<ruby>探<rt>さが</rt></ruby>していたらしい。」<ruby>薄<rt>うす</rt></ruby>い<ruby>煙草<rt>たばこ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>煙<rt>けむり</rt></ruby>がカウンターの<ruby>上<rt>うえ</rt></ruby>を<ruby>漂<rt>ただよ</rt></ruby>い、テストは<ruby>言葉<rt>ことば</rt></ruby>を<ruby>失<rt>うしな</rt></ruby>ったまま<ruby>男<rt>おとこ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>顔<rt>かお</rt></ruby>を<ruby>見<rt>み</rt></ruby>つめた。それから<ruby>男<rt>おとこ</rt></ruby>は、まるで<ruby>独<rt>ひと</rt></ruby>り<ruby>言<rt>ごと</rt></ruby>を<ruby>言<rt>い</rt></ruby>うかのように<ruby>付<rt>つ</rt></ruby>け<ruby>加<rt>くわ</rt></ruby>えた。「<ruby>最後<rt>さいご</rt></ruby>に<ruby>来<rt>き</rt></ruby>た<ruby>夜<rt>よる</rt></ruby>、<ruby>彼女<rt>かのじょ</rt></ruby>はこれを<ruby>置<rt>お</rt></ruby>いていった。」<ruby>男<rt>おとこ</rt></ruby>がカウンターの<ruby>下<rt>した</rt></ruby>から<ruby>取<rt>と</rt></ruby>り<ruby>出<rt>だ</rt></ruby>したのは、<ruby>古<rt>ふる</rt></ruby>びた<ruby>封筒<rt>ふうとう</rt></ruby>だった。<ruby>表<rt>おもて</rt></ruby>には、テストという<ruby>名前<rt>なまえ</rt></ruby>が<ruby>書<rt>か</rt></ruby>かれていた。
scene_translation: The bartender slowly opened his mouth, polishing a glass. "Your grandmother used to come here once a month. It seems she was searching for something." Thin cigarette smoke drifted across the counter, and Tesuto stared at the man's face, struck speechless. Then the man added, almost as if talking to himself: "The last night she came, she left this behind." What the man produced from beneath the counter was a worn, weathered envelope. On the front, the name 'Tesuto' was written.
grammar_note: 【まるで〜かのように】'just as if / as though ~' — a simile construction combining まるで (just like) with かのように (as if it were). Here: まるで独り言を言うかのように (as though he were talking to himself). Note how かのように follows the plain form of the verb — this is an N3 pattern for vivid, literary comparisons.

mystery_memo: The envelope addressed to Tesuto (the player) was left by the grandmother on her final visit — establishing she anticipated her grandchild would one day come here. The bartender is now a key figure: warm but carefully measured, clearly protective of old secrets. He knows more than he has said. The woman in blue remains unseen but is likely connected to the grandmother's search. The envelope's contents will be a central clue when opened — probably a name, address, or fragmentary message.
